name: cadence-monorepo
description: Cadence — Autonomous Real-Time Voice Systems Architect

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.start: concurrently -n "server,client" -c "magenta,cyan" "cd server && npm start" "cd client && npm run preview"
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
